# Appendix: Which Method Do I Need? {#sec-appendix-reference}

This appendix is an index organized by task. When you know what you want to check or do but not which
method does it, find the task in the tables below, and the last column points to the chapter that
explains it. The tables list method names only. For full signatures and every argument, see the
docstrings in your installed version of Pointblank or the online API reference at
<https://posit-dev.github.io/pointblank/reference/>, both of which stay current as the library
changes.
